lastCompletedStory.title: Redirect the terminal-verdict hook sink from issue-filing to the pen

nextStoryContext: makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) now appends surviving reviewer SUGGESTIONs to scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl via appendSuggestionOnMain (US-001) instead of filing idea-stage issues; the fileCandidates helper was renamed/rewritten to appendCandidates and no longer imports createLocalIssueOnMain/resolveIssueId/parseToml (the pen schema's sourceIssue is a raw provenance.parentIssue number, no issue-prefix resolution needed). dedupSuggestions (src/supervisor/suggestion-followups.ts) grew a third optional parameter penFingerprints: Iterable<string> = [] that unions into the SAME Set the open-backlog scan already builds, so callers passing only 2 args (existing test/suggestion-followups.test.ts) are unaffected; the sidecar closure resolves both sources via readBacklogFromMain + readSuggestionsFromMain(cwd, spawnFn).map(e => e.fingerprint) before calling in. fileSuggestionsFn's return shape changed from { filedIds: string[]; dupSkipped: number } to { penned: number; dupSkipped: number } -- this is a breaking type change threaded through RunSidecarLoopOptions['fileSuggestionsFn'] (src/supervisor/loop.ts), SuggestionFiledEventDetail (src/supervisor/events.ts, filedIds -> penned), and the orchestrator notify-line text ('[cam] penned N SUGGESTION follow-up(s)[, M dup-skipped]', no issue ids). loop.ts's trigger/gate-matrix (fires on complete+awaiting-operator when prd.review.lastVerdict is TERMINAL_VERDICTS, no fire-once marker, dedup by fingerprint only) is UNCHANGED -- only the sink changed, per this story's AC3. The next story in this PRD (per the branch's remaining backlog, likely a 'cam suggestions list/promote/dismiss' CLI, CAM-285) should build on readSuggestionsFromMain (already exported from src/commands/suggestions.ts, US-001) to render/triage the pen; issues 277-280 (already-filed SUGGESTION issues from before this cutover) are correctly excluded from re-penning by the backlog half of the dedup union, so they remain the only SUGGESTION-derived items in the issue backlog going forward -- new terminal reviews land in the pen instead.
